description: Attach a supporting document (invoice, contract or other) to a transfer or a payment route deposit, for example when Stables compliance asks for one. The file goes as a base64 data URL ('data:application/pdf;base64,...').

base64Url.description: The file as a data URL: 'data:<mime>;base64,<data>'

fileName.description: File name shown to Stables, e.g. 'invoice-2041.pdf'

on.description: What the document belongs to: a transfer, or a deposit on a payment route

transactionId.description: The transfer ID, or the deposit ID from get_virtual_account_history

name: add_document
title: Add document
